# Brand Overview & Technical Standards | Ecomshoot

- **Production URL**: https://www.ecomshoots.in/business/brand-overview.md
- **Alternative URL**: https://www.ecomshoots.in/brand-overview.md

---

## Brand Purpose & Core Philosophy
Ecomshoot was founded to bridge the gap between slow, prohibitive commercial advertising studios and low-quality catalog cutout mills. We engineer high-performance visual assets designed specifically to increase click-through rates, drive add-to-cart actions, and eliminate product returns for e-commerce brands.

## The Ecomshoot Technical Pillars

### 1. Optical Acuity & Medium Format Capture
We shoot on 100+ megapixel medium format systems (High-resolution commercial digital systems) and high-resolution Sony full-frame sensors paired with specialized calibrated commercial prime and prime tilt-shift optics. This delivers unmatched resolution, allowing digital shoppers to inspect microscopic fabric weaves and fine product finishes.

### 2. Spectral Color Fidelity (ΔE < 1.0)
Inaccurate product color is the single largest driver of e-commerce returns. We photograph custom X-Rite ColorChecker charts under calibrated 5600K Calibrated studio strobe illumination to construct proprietary ICC color profiles for every shoot session.

### 3. Zero AI Hallucination Guarantee
We capture authentic physical products under true optical glass. We never use generative AI diffusion models to fabricate product geometry or synthetic surfaces that mislead buyers.

### 4. 100% Hand-Crafted Post-Production
Automated cutout algorithms leave telltale jagged halos and washed-out edges. Every Ecomshoot asset is clipped using hand-drawn vector paths by senior retouchers, paired with frequency separation and natural contact shadow reconstruction.

### 5. Frictionless Turnaround (Flexible Turnaround Schedules)
With an intake-to-delivery pipeline engineered for high-throughput D2C inventory cycles, standard catalogs are delivered within Turnaround time depends on project scope, volume, and post-production requirements. Expedited turnaround options are available for urgent campaign schedules..

## Section 6: Our 5 Stage Production Process

- **Tagline Badge**: 5 Stage Process
- **Section Heading (H2)**: Our 5 Stage Process
- **Section Subtitle**: An easy and transparent process from start to finish.

### Sequential Workflow Stages
1. **01. Creative Brief**: We find out about your product, audience and sales channels. We then agree on the look you want.
2. **02. Concept & Planning**: We plan your angles, backgrounds, props and shot list to ensure your shoot runs smoothly.
3. **03. Studio Shoot**: We shoot your products in our Delhi studio using professional lighting and styling.
4. **04. Editing & Retouching**: We colour correct, clean up and enhance your images to match your brand and marketplace guidelines.
5. **05. Final Deliverables**: You will receive organised files ready for upload in the correct formats and sizes.

## Section 7: Industries We Shoot (Tailored Lighting Setups)

- **Tagline Badge**: Lighting Setups
- **Section Heading (H2)**: Industries We Shoot
- **Section Subtitle**: We use different lighting set ups depending on your product type. Glass, metal, fabric and skincare packaging all react differently to light.

### Six Industry Lighting Architectures
1. **Beauty & Cosmetics (Sparkle Icon)**: Soft lighting to capture accurate shading and clean reflective packaging.
2. **Fashion & Apparel (Dress Icon)**: Even lighting to capture fabric textures, colours and fit.
3. **Luxury Jewellery (Diamond Icon)**: We use precise lighting to highlight your stones, polished metal and detail.
4. **Lifestyle & Living (Couch Icon)**: Warm lighting to create a natural feel and showcase your product in a realistic environment.
5. **Consumer Electronics (Plug Icon)**: Clean sharp lines, controlled reflections and clear ports/buttons.
6. **Home & Storage (Wine Glass Icon)**: Practical images with good lighting to showcase size, material and use.

## Section 10: Frequently Asked Questions

- **Tagline Badge**: Frequently Asked Questions
- **Section Heading (H2)**: Answers to some common questions.
- **Section Subtitle**: Everything you need to know about sample shipments, shoot turnarounds, licensing rights, and image deliverables.

### Full Questions and Answers
1. **Q: How does product delivery and sampling work?**
   **A:** You can send your products to our studio in Delhi via courier or hand delivery. We will log your product, shoot and return safely once the project has been completed.
2. **Q: How long does it take to produce?**
   **A:** Turnaround time depends on project scope, volume, and post-production requirements. Expedited turnaround options are available for urgent campaign schedules.
3. **Q: Do you offer commercial use and licensing?**
   **A:** Yes! Once your project has been paid for you will have full commercial use rights for your website, marketplaces, ads and social media.
4. **Q: Can you shoot for Amazon & Shopify?**
   **A:** Yes! We follow all guidelines from Amazon, Flipkart & Shopify. This includes white background, sizing and aspect ratio.
5. **Q: How much does product photography in Delhi cost?**
   **A:** The cost depends on how many products you have, what type of shots you want and how much editing. Please send us your list of products and we will give you a clear quote with no hidden costs.
6. **Q: What if I’m not satisfied with my results?**
   **A:** Let us know what changes you would like and we will make the changes within the agreed scope.

## Section 2: Company Overview & Studio Heritage

### Tagline Badge
- **Our Story**

### Section Heading (H2)
**Why E-Commerce Photography Needed an Engineering Overhaul**

### Editorial Lead
Traditional commercial photography studios were designed for print magazines and seasonal billboards—slow, prohibitively expensive, and detached from the operational realities of direct-to-consumer inventory cycles.

### Body Narrative
At the other extreme, low-cost catalog mills deliver washed-out packshots with sloppy automated cutouts, inaccurate color casts, and zero understanding of brand nuance.

Ecomshoot was established in Delhi to solve this dilemma. We built a specialized commercial production house designed from the ground up to satisfy the rigorous technical requirements of Amazon, Shopify Plus, and omnichannel luxury retailers without sacrificing editorial warmth or tactile realism.

### Studio Visuals & Callout
- **Featured Facility Asset**: `https://www.ecomshoots.in/assets/images/about/studio-bay.jpg` (Ecomshoot Commercial Photography Studio Facility and Staging Bay)
- **Verified Stat Card**: **100%** Tethered Proofing & Calibrated Optics

---

## Section 3: Technical Hardware & Studio Capabilities

### Tagline Badge
- **Technical Excellence**

### Section Heading (H2)
**Hardware & Studio Capabilities**

### Section Subtitle
We invest relentlessly in medium format optics, calibrated power packs, and specialized staging rigs to deliver pristine clarity.

### Four Technical Pillars
1. **Medium Format Acuity (Optics Pillar)**:
   - High-resolution commercial digital systems digital systems and calibrated commercial prime optics resolving fine micro-textures down to single textile threads.
2. **Broncolor Strobes (Lighting Pillar)**:
   - Calibrated studio strobes with high-speed flash duration to freeze kinetic liquid splashes and guarantee constant 5600K color consistency.
3. **Motorized Indexing Rails (Rigs Pillar)**:
   - Automated 20-micron focus rails for 60-slice jewellery focus-stacking composites and seamless 360-degree interactive product spin tables.
4. **Color Managed Flow (Color Pillar)**:
   - Hardware-calibrated hardware-calibrated proofing monitors, spectrophotometer audits, and custom ICC profiles ensuring ΔE < 1.0 color accuracy.

Four non-negotiable operational commitments that safeguard your brand reputation and bottom line.

## Section 4: Sample Shipment & Logistics Guidelines

1. **Packaging**: Send items in original retail packaging with protective exterior boxing.
2. **Sample Selection**: Inspect samples beforehand for surface blemishes, scratches, or manufacturing flaws. Send at least 2 units for hero items when possible.
3. **Labeling**: Include a packing slip with Brand Name, Contact Person, SKU Count, and Special Handling Instructions.
4. **Return Logistics**: After shooting and approval, products are carefully re-packed and returned via prepaid courier or made available for local pickup.

### Context
Here’s how we will create your product photoshoot in Delhi.

### Workflow Sequence

03. **Tethered Capture & Live Proofing**: Shooting tethered to Capture One Pro with live client web proofing links for instant real-time feedback and shot sign-off.
04. **Master Retouching & Compliance QA**: Dust removal, scratch elimination, color correction against physical references, and standardized web optimization.

## Section 7: Frequently Asked Questions

### Context


### Question 1: How do you ensure lighting remains identical when we send products months apart?
**Answer**: Every client has a proprietary Digital Lighting Recipe document recording exact strobe power settings, light modifier distances, focal lengths, camera heights, and color balance profiles.

### Question 2: Can you handle hundreds of color variations?
**Answer**: Yes, our production facility features automated batch workflows designed specifically for high-count SKU matrices and seasonal collection drops.

### Question 3: Do you deliver files with custom SKU filenames?
**Answer**: Yes! Simply provide your SKU spreadsheet, and our asset management script renames all final renders to your exact specification (e.g., SKU_01_HERO.webp, SKU_02_ANGLE.webp).

### Question 4: Are these photos ready for Shopify and Amazon?
**Answer**: Every deliverable is pre-scaled to square 2000x2000px or 3000x3000px at 72DPI with sRGB color space, ready for immediate platform upload.

### Workflow Sequence

03. **Softbox & Rim Light Calibration**: We craft diffuse key lighting paired with delicate rim highlights that carve out the fabric texture from the backdrop.
04. **Composite Stitching & Color Alignment**: Our digital artists composite ghost necklines, remove support pins, smooth minor fabric tension lines, and calibrate textile color.

## Section 7: Frequently Asked Questions

### Context


### Question 1: What is the difference between ghost mannequin and flat lay?
**Answer**: Ghost mannequin gives garments a hollow-man 3D shape as if worn by an invisible person, ideal for jackets, blazers, and shirts. Flat lay presents garments styled flat on a table, ideal for tees, casual knitwear, and accessories.

### Question 2: Can we hire diverse models through Ecomshoot?
**Answer**: Yes, we have relationships with premier model agencies representing diverse ethnicities, body types, and aesthetics. We manage castings, bookings, and release agreements.

### Question 3: How do you handle difficult reflective fabrics like satin or vinyl?
**Answer**: Our studio uses polarized lighting filters and large scrim diffusers that control harsh highlights while maintaining the lustrous character of satin, velvet, and coated technical materials.

### Question 4: Do you steam the garments prior to photography?
**Answer**: Yes! Professional industrial-grade fabric steaming and lint preparation are standard parts of our intake process at no extra fee.

Highly reflective metals act like mirrors, diamonds scatter light into fiery chromatic aberrations, and miniature proportions require microscopic depth of field. At Ecomshoot, our dedicated luxury studio is equipped with customized diffusers, motorized focus rails, and cleanroom air filters that eliminate the dust particles invisible to the human eye.

### Studio Follow-up
Our lighting and styling will reflect how you would like to sell your products. Whether you are selling in a traditional showroom in Karol Bagh or Chandni Chowk, a modern store in South Extension or Khan Market, or online for your D2C brand.

2. **True Metallic Lustre**: 18K yellow gold, rose gold, platinum, and sterling silver rendered with accurate warmth, mirror sheen, and zero color contamination.
3. **Edge-to-Edge Razor Sharpness**: Automated 30-to-80 frame focus-stacking composites ensure the entire ring band, prong, and gemstone are in tack-sharp focus.

- **Custom Diffuse Light Cones**: Proprietary 360-degree diffusion enclosures that wrap precious rings in immaculate, seamless reflection-free illumination.
- **Micro-Retouching & Gem Polish**: Pixel-level post-production removing microscopic micro-scratches, aligning prong symmetry, and brightening diamond tables.
- **Shadow & Mirror Floor Treatments**: Options for floating transparent backgrounds, subtle gradient drop shadows, or pristine high-gloss mirror reflections.

- **Fine Gold & Silver Necklaces**: Delicate chains arranged with graceful serpentine geometry, free of tangles, kinks, or uneven link shadows.
- **Gemstone Earrings & Bracelets**: Emerald, ruby, sapphire, and pearl pieces lit to balance vibrant saturated color with transparent internal light play.

---

## Section 6: Step-by-Step Production Process

### Heading (H2)
**How We Work**

### Context
Below is an example of how we would work on a typical project. Everything will be planned upfront to avoid any surprises. We can also provide updates on your project.

### Workflow Sequence
01. **Cleanroom Ultrasonic Preparation**: Jewellery is immersed in ultrasonic cleaners, wiped with lint-free optical microfiber, and handled exclusively with anti-static gloves.
02. **Precision Rigging & Articulation**: Rings and pendants are mounted on micro-thin invisible monofilament or proprietary museum-grade mounting putty.
03. **Motorized 50-Slice Focus Stacking**: Our tethered macro lens records 30 to 80 consecutive exposures as the rail shifts focus from the front stone tip to the rear band.
04. **Focus Stacking & High-End Retouching**: Helicon Focus compiles the sharpest pixels from every slice; our senior retouchers hand-polish every facet and contour.

---

## Section 7: Frequently Asked Questions

### Context


### Question 1: Why is focus stacking necessary for jewellery?
**Answer**: At macro magnification, the physical depth of field of even an f/16 lens is less than 1 millimeter. Focus stacking captures dozens of images across the product depth and stitches them into a single frame where every detail is in focus.

### Question 2: How do you secure valuable high-ticket merchandise?
**Answer**: Our studio maintains biometric security, 24/7 video surveillance, a dual-combination safe, and comprehensive commercial inland marine insurance covering valuable goods in transit and on premises.

### Question 3: Can you accurately capture the difference between 14k and 18k yellow gold?
**Answer**: Yes, our color-managed pipeline uses custom ICC camera calibration profiles that capture subtle differences between gold karat purities and rose gold alloys.

### Question 4: Do you shoot 360-degree interactive jewellery spins?
**Answer**: Yes, we provide 360-degree spin photography captured on motorized indexing tables, outputting smooth HTML5/GIF interactive widgets.

# Frequently Asked Questions (Master Studio FAQ) | Ecomshoot

- **Production URL**: https://www.ecomshoots.in/resources/faq.md
- **Alternative URL**: https://www.ecomshoots.in/faq.md
- **Topic**: Studio operations, logistics, turnaround times, licensing rights, equipment, and compliance standards.

---

## 1. Product Ingestion & Sample Logistics

### How does product delivery and sampling work?
You can send your products to our studio in Delhi via courier or hand delivery. We will log your product into our intake system, shoot, and return safely once the project has been completed. Pre-addressed shipping tags and barcode tracking are provided upon booking.

### Where is your studio located for shipments?
Ecomshoot  
Okhla Industrial Area, Phase III, New Delhi, Delhi 110020, India.  
Intake hours: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:30 PM IST; Saturday 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM IST.

### How should we prepare products before shipping?
- Inspect products for surface scratches, dings, or manufacturing imperfections.
- Send products in original retail boxes with bubble wrap.
- For hero SKUs, send 2 duplicate units if possible to ensure the cleanest sample is shot.
- Include an intake packing slip with your brand name, contact person, and SKU count.

---

## 2. Production Schedules & Turnaround

### How long does a production shoot take?
Turnaround time depends on project scope, volume, and post-production requirements. Expedited turnaround options are available for urgent campaign schedules.

### Can we participate in the shoot remotely?
Yes! We shoot 100% tethered to Capture One Pro and stream live proofing links. You can view high-resolution captures in real time on your desktop or mobile, provide art direction comments, and approve hero angles before the set is struck.

---

## 3. Commercial Licensing & Usage Rights

### Do you offer commercial use and licensing?
Yes! Once your project has been paid for, you receive full, worldwide, perpetual commercial usage rights. You can use the imagery across your e-commerce store, Amazon, Flipkart, social media advertising, print catalogs, packaging, and billboards with zero recurring royalties.

### Are RAW camera files included?
Standard delivery includes color-corrected, 16-bit Master TIFFs, full-resolution uncompressed JPEGs (300 DPI), and web-optimized WebP files. High-resolution medium format RAW files (Medium-Format / Full-Frame RAW) can be archived and provided upon request.

---

## 4. Marketplace Compliance & Technical Standards

### Can you shoot compliant imagery for Amazon, Shopify & Flipkart?
Yes! We strictly follow all marketplace specifications:
- **Pure White Background**: True #FFFFFF background with natural contact drop shadows.
- **Frame Occupancy**: 85%+ product frame fill without edge cropping.
- **Dimensions**: Square 3000 x 3000 px or custom aspect ratios, formatted to trigger high-resolution zoom-to-inspect tools.
- **Color Profile**: Embedded sRGB for universal digital screen fidelity.

### What cameras and lighting do you use?
We shoot on High-resolution commercial digital systems medium format systems and Sony Alpha 61MP bodies paired with prime tilt-shift lenses and Calibrated studio strobes (Scoro power packs delivering constant 5600K color temperature and 1/10,000s motion-freezing flash durations).

---

## 5. Pricing, Estimates & Guarantees

### How much does product photography in Delhi cost?
Pricing is calculated based on SKU volume, required angles per product (e.g. 3-angle, 5-angle, 7-angle sets), styling complexity (white background packshot vs. styled lifestyle interior), and specialized retouching (e.g. jewellery focus stacking). We provide transparent rate cards with no hidden studio fees.

### What is the 1 SKU Complimentary Test Shoot?
For qualified brands with multi-SKU catalogs, we offer a complimentary 1 SKU test shoot. Send us one product, and our team will light, photograph, and retouch it to your exact brief so you can evaluate our technical quality firsthand before committing to a catalog production run.

### What if I am not satisfied with the results?
We provide clear pre-production mood boards and live tethered proofing during the shoot. If minor adjustments are required in post-production (color hue balance, crop ratio, shadow density), we perform revisions within the agreed scope until 100% satisfaction is achieved.

4.2. 5-STAGE STUDIO PRODUCTION ROADMAP
URL: https://www.ecomshoots.in/resources/process.md
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5-Stage Studio Production Roadmap | Ecomshoot

- **Production URL**: https://www.ecomshoots.in/resources/process.md
- **Alternative URL**: https://www.ecomshoots.in/process.md
- **Topic**: Complete end-to-end operational production workflow from intake to cloud delivery.

---

## Stage 01: Pre-Production & Creative Briefing
- **Client Onboarding**: Review brand guidelines, typography standards, target sales channels (Amazon, Shopify, DTC, Instagram ads).
- **Shot List Architecture**: Construct an itemized shot list categorizing each SKU by angle (Hero 0°, 45° isometric, profile, top-down flat lay, macro detail, packaging).
- **Prop & Mood Board Sourcing**: For lifestyle and creative campaigns, our art directors curate tactile props, organic surfaces (stone, marble, aged wood, brushed linen), and custom color palettes.

## Stage 02: Logistics, Ingestion & Product Prep
- **Intake Logging**: Products arrive at our Delhi facility, barcodes scanned, and stored in secure climate-controlled staging bays.
- **Condition Audit**: Under calibrated 5000K daylight lighting, each sample is inspected for scratches or defects.
- **Preparation & Styling**: Garments are steamed with industrial steamers; jewellery is ultrasonically cleaned; glass and acrylic packaging are treated with anti-static ionizing brushes.

## Stage 03: The Studio Shoot & Tethered Capture
- **Lighting Architecture**: Tailored lighting modifiers (Calibrated studio reflectors, softboxes, cross-polarized diffusers) are dialed in according to surface reflectivity.
- **Medium Format Capture**: Products are captured on High-resolution commercial digital systems digital backs or Sony 61MP bodies tethered directly to Capture One Pro.
- **Color Calibration**: X-Rite ColorChecker Digital SG targets are photographed under the exact lighting setup to generate custom ICC profiles ensuring ΔE < 1.0 color accuracy.
- **Live Client Proofing**: Remote clients receive live web gallery links to review and approve captures in real time.

## Stage 04: Master Post-Production & Digital Retouching
- **100% Vector Pen Tool Clipping**: Products are extracted using meticulous hand-drawn bezier paths (no automated AI fuzzy cutouts).
- **Surface Cleanup**: Dust specks, lint, micro-scratches, and packaging seams are removed while preserving genuine material texture.
- **Frequency Separation**: Complex textures (fabrics, cosmetics, leather) are retouched using dual-frequency separation to smooth blemishes without blurring authentic weave.
- **Drop Shadow Crafting**: Realistic contact shadows and ambient occlusion drop shadows are hand-rendered to anchor the product naturally.

## Stage 05: Multi-Format Handoff & Cloud Delivery
- **Export Standards**: Assets are exported in multiple resolutions:
  - High-res Master TIFF (16-bit, ProPhoto RGB or Adobe RGB) for print and archiving.
  - Full-res JPEG (3000x3000px, 300 DPI, sRGB) for marketplace catalogs.
  - Compressed WebP/JPEG for fast-loading e-commerce web storefronts.
- **Delivery Platform**: Organized cloud storage with permanent download links provided to the client team.

# How High-Resolution Product Photography Directly Boosts Shopify Conversion Rates

> Discover the empirical connection between visual resolution, multi-angle imagery, and customer checkout conversion rates on modern Shopify stores.

# The Visual Science of E-Commerce Conversion

In physical retail, purchasing decisions are tactile. Shoppers run their fingertips across the grain of a leather wallet, test the spring resistance of a sports shoe, examine the weight of a watch, and inspect stitching up close. 

In digital commerce, **every single one of those sensory touchpoints must be translated through light and pixels.**

When a potential buyer lands on your Shopify product page, they are fundamentally making an assessment of risk. Is this product legitimate? Does the material feel cheap? Will the color match my expectations when the parcel arrives?

```
Conversion Confidence = (Visual Clarity + Information Completeness) / Perceived Risk
```

## The Three Visual Pillars of High-Converting Stores

### 1. Optical Resolution and Micro-Texture Rendering
Low-resolution images act like a foggy shop window. If an online shopper attempts to pinch-to-zoom on your hero image and encounters blocky artifacts or blurry edges, their subconscious registers lower product quality. 

Using medium-format camera systems, we capture over 100 million pixels of raw visual data. This allows users to zoom into:
- The organic weave of linen apparel
- The brushed bevel of metallic consumer tech
- The matte or gloss coat of cosmetics packaging

### 2. Standardized Multi-Angle Sequences
One hero photograph is never enough to overcome purchase hesitation. Our empirical testing with high-volume D2C clients demonstrates that moving from **2 images to 7 standardized angles** increases checkout completion by an average of **34%**.

Recommended 7-shot sequence:
1. **Hero Shot**: 45-degree isometric view on clean neutral ground
2. **Direct Front**: Straight-on profile showing balanced proportions
3. **Side & Silhouette**: Revealing product depth and slimness
4. **Back & Details**: Showing closure mechanisms, ports, or rear details
5. **Macro Close-Up**: Extreme zoom of critical hardware or branding
6. **In-Hand / Human Scale**: Contextual shot demonstrating true physical dimensions
7. **Lifestyle In-Context**: Inspiring aspirational usage in real environments

### 3. Absolute Color Fidelity
Mismatched colors between the screen and the physical product are the number one cause of e-commerce apparel and home goods returns. By utilizing hardware-calibrated X-Rite ColorChecker targets and custom ICC profiles, Ecomshoot locks color deviation ($Delta E$) below 1.5, well below the threshold of human visual perception.

## Key Takeaway
Investing in professional studio imagery is not a decorative marketing expense—it is a foundational conversion engine that pays dividends on every single paid ad dollar sent to your store.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What image resolution is optimal for Shopify?

Shopify recommends square images between 2048 x 2048 pixels and 4472 x 4472 pixels for smooth pinch-to-zoom without overwhelming mobile bandwidth.

### How many images should each product listing have?

We recommend a minimum of 5 to 7 images per SKU to satisfy all customer risk assessments.

# Mastering the Art of Pure White Background Photography: Studio Setup & Lighting

> A technical masterclass into achieving true #FFFFFF white background photographs without washing out product edges or losing specular highlights.

# The Myth of Overexposing the Backdrop

Many amateur photographers assume that achieving a pure white background simply means blasting a white paper backdrop with maximum strobe power. 

**This is the fastest way to ruin a product photo.**

When you overwhelm your background with excessive light, that light bounces back toward the camera lens, wrapping around the edges of your product. This phenomenon—known as **specular edge bleed** or flare—washes out delicate silhouettes, washes away fine details, and introduces a milky gray veil over your contrast.

## The Balanced Four-Light Studio Architecture

To achieve a true pure white (#FFFFFF) background while preserving tack-sharp product boundaries, you must decouple background illumination from subject lighting entirely.

| Light Role | Modifier | Purpose | Recommended Power Ratio |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Background Left** | Stripbox with Grid | Even white distribution | +1.5 stops over key |
| **Background Right** | Stripbox with Grid | Eliminates shadow falloff | +1.5 stops over key |
| **Main Key Light** | Octabox with Diffuser | Shapes product contours | Base exposure (f/11) |
| **Fill / Rim** | Silver Reflector / Strip | Opens dark shadows | -1.5 stops under key |

### Step 1: Distance Is Your Protective Shield
Place your product at least **6 to 8 feet in front of the white backdrop**. The inverse-square law dictates that light intensity diminishes exponentially with distance. Increasing the physical gap between your product and the background guarantees that backdrop bounce cannot contaminate your subject.

### Step 2: The Black Card Flagging Technique
When photographing shiny or light-colored items (such as white cosmetic bottles or silver jewellery) against a white backdrop, the edges can blend invisibly into the background.

The solution is simple yet transformative: **Black foam-core flags**. 
By placing narrow black strips just outside the camera frame on either side of the product, the glossy edges reflect the black card, carving out crisp, razor-sharp dark boundary lines that define the shape with absolute precision.

### Step 3: Measuring with the Digital Eyedropper
Never trust your naked eye or an uncalibrated monitor. In Capture One or Photoshop:
- Inspect the four corners of your background canvas with the color sampler.
- The numbers must read **R: 255, G: 255, B: 255**.
- Inspect the outer rim of your product. If the edge pixels jump from 255 directly to 230 without gradual antialiasing, your backlight was too intense.

## Conclusion
True studio packshot excellence is born from control, not raw power. With proper distance, deliberate flagging, and balanced light ratios, pure white photography becomes a reproducible science.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Why does my white background look grayish after uploading?

If the camera raw value is even slightly below 255 (e.g. 250, 250, 250), it will display as a dingy off-white box against pure white web pages.

### Should I use continuous LED or strobe lighting for white backgrounds?

High-output studio strobes with fast flash durations are superior for product photography because they easily overpower ambient room light and freeze any micro-vibrations.

# Amazon Product Image Guidelines 2026: Complete Compliance & Best Practices

> Stay ahead of Amazon algorithm updates and seller central image standards to prevent listing suppression and capture the Buy Box.

# The Critical Role of Image Compliance on Amazon

On Amazon, your main hero image (known internally as `MAIN`) is the single most critical asset in your entire seller account. It determines your **Search Impressions to Click-Through Rate (CTR)** on the search results page.

However, Amazon employs strict computer-vision algorithms that automatically scan and suppress listings that fail to meet strict style guide criteria. Having your best-selling ASIN suppressed during a holiday sales peak can cost tens of thousands of dollars in lost revenue.

## Amazon MAIN Image Mandatory Rules

Here is the authoritative checklist your primary image must satisfy:

1. **Pure White Background**: Must be pure sRGB white (`#FFFFFF` or #FFFFFF).
2. **85% Frame Occupancy**: The product must fill at least 85% of the total image canvas area. Excess dead white border space will trigger listing warnings.
3. **No Added Text, Badges, or Watermarks**: Graphics claiming "Best Seller", "100% Organic", sale percentages, or brand logos not physically part of the product are strictly prohibited on the MAIN image.
4. **Physical Product Only**: No illustrations, 3D mockups, or vector sketches. Must be a genuine photograph of the physical item.
5. **No Extraneous Accessories**: Do not display items that are not included in the purchase box. If you sell a camera lens, do not photograph the camera body on the MAIN image unless it is part of the bundle.
6. **High Resolution for Zoom**: Minimum dimension of 1600 pixels on the longest side (Ecomshoot standards deliver 3000 x 3000 pixels at 1:1 square ratio for maximum pinch-to-zoom utility).

```
Amazon Main Image Formula:
[Actual Physical Product] + [Pure #FFFFFF Background] + [85% Canvas Fill] + [3000x3000px] = Zero Suppression Risk
```

## Optimizing Secondary Images (Slots 2 Through 7)

While the MAIN image has rigid legal constraints, your secondary images offer total creative freedom to build your brand story and handle customer objections:

- **Infographic Breakdown (Slot 2)**: Call out key technical dimensions, ingredients, or construction materials with elegant pointer lines.
- **Scale Comparison (Slot 3)**: Place the product next to common everyday items or in a human hand to demonstrate actual real-world size.
- **Problem vs. Solution (Slot 4)**: Visually demonstrate the pain point your product solves compared to generic alternatives.
- **Lifestyle Emotional Hook (Slots 5 & 6)**: High-production lifestyle images showing happy target demographics enjoying the product benefits.
- **Packaging & Unboxing (Slot 7)**: Showcase premium gift boxes, instructions, and bundled accessories to build unboxing anticipation.

## Partnering with Ecomshoot for Amazon Success
At Ecomshoot, our automated quality assurance script verifies every deliverable against Amazon Seller Central API requirements before the files ever reach your inbox.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What happens if Amazon flags my main image?

Your listing is placed into a suppressed status, meaning it will completely disappear from search results and category navigation until a compliant image is uploaded and approved.

### Can we use props in secondary images on Amazon?

Yes! Props, infographics, text overlays, and lifestyle backgrounds are fully allowed on secondary images (slots 2 through 9).
